scenario: Burst attack detected via time-based velocity and merchant clustering

evidence.description: 47 transactions in 3 minutes targeted at Merchant M3301
Transactions originate from 23 distinct cities within 180 seconds
Merchant M3301 normally processes 12 txn/hour; currently 47 in 3 min

expected_output.narrative: Merchant M3301 under active burst attack: 47 transactions from 23 cities in 3 minutes — a 40x spike over normal velocity. First-digit distribution shows extreme Benford deviation (chi2=89.3), indicative of synthetic transaction generation.
expected_output.reasoning: Massive velocity spike combined with impossible geographic distribution and anomalous first-digit patterns indicates automated scripted attack. Merchant account should be temporarily suspended.
